organization_id.description: Canonical Organization record ID responsible for this billing event.

billing_event_key.description: Stable unique idempotency key for this billing event, used to prevent duplicate charges.

fee_kind.description: Type of charge or billing adjustment.

event_status.description: Billing lifecycle status. Pending records do not charge anyone.

billing_subject_type.description: What the billing event applies to.

subject_user_id.description: Registered User ID associated with this event, when the event concerns a person.

subject_verified_email.description: Verified email permanently associated with the billed person at the time this event was created.

organization_membership_id.description: OrganizationMembership record connected to this billing event, when applicable.

cohort_id.description: CETrainingCohort record connected to this event, when applicable.

organization_plan_subscription_id.description: OrganizationPlanSubscription record connected to this billing event, when applicable.

pricing_schedule_id.description: PlatformPricingSchedule record that supplied the locked price for this billing event.

pricing_schedule_key_snapshot.description: Copied pricing schedule key retained for readable legacy-pricing history.

pricing_schedule_item_id.description: PlatformPricingScheduleItem record that supplied the exact amount for this billing event.

pricing_item_key_snapshot.description: Copied pricing item key retained for readable billing history even after future pricing changes.

feature_key.description: Platform feature or capacity key connected to this event, such as ce_cohorts or employee_seats.

quantity.description: Billable quantity represented by this event.

unit_amount_cents.description: Charge per unit in cents. For example, 4900 represents a $49 registration fee.

amount_cents.description: Total event amount in cents after quantity and any approved adjustments.

billing_period_starts_at.description: Beginning of the recurring billing period when this is a monthly charge.

billing_period_ends_at.description: End of the recurring billing period when this is a monthly charge.

triggered_at.description: When the billing event was created.

paid_at.description: When payment was confirmed, if applicable.

waived_at.description: When an authorized platform user waived the charge, if applicable.

waived_by_user_id.description: Platform user who authorized a fee waiver, if applicable.

waiver_reason.description: Required internal reason when a charge is waived.

stripe_checkout_session_id.description: Stripe Checkout Session ID once payment collection is connected.

stripe_invoice_id.description: Stripe Invoice ID once billing is connected.

stripe_payment_intent_id.description: Stripe Payment Intent ID once billing is connected.

registration_settlement_email_sent_at.description: When the student was sent post-settlement CE registration instructions after this billing event was paid or waived.

registration_settlement_email_provider_i.description: Transactional email provider message ID for the post-settlement CE registration instructions.

registration_settlement_email_last_attem.description: Most recent attempted delivery time for the post-settlement CE registration instructions.

registration_settlement_email_last_error.description: Most recent non-sensitive delivery error for post-settlement CE registration instructions. Blank after a successful send.
